nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 collateral asset held in custody by the locker
Immutable address of the Loan contract authorized to pull collateral
Constructor setting collateralAsset and loan immutables from arguments
External isLoan-guarded function transferring collateral asset to dst
Modifier requiring msg.sender equals the stored loan address
Caller address, untrusted input used in the isLoan authorization check
External token transfer via SafeERC20 that hands control to the collateral asset contract
Constructor parameter for the collateral asset address
Constructor parameter for the authorized loan address
Destination address of the collateral transfer in pull
Amount of collateral asset transferred in pull

edges.reason: Constructor stores the _collateralAsset parameter into the collateralAsset immutable state variable
Constructor stores the _loan parameter into the loan immutable state variable
isLoan modifier compares untrusted msg.sender against the stored loan address
The isLoan modifier gates execution of pull before the transfer occurs
Only the caller satisfying msg.sender == loan may reach the pull body
pull uses the collateralAsset state variable as the token target of safeTransfer
dst parameter is forwarded as the recipient of the external safeTransfer
amt parameter is forwarded as the value of the external safeTransfer
pull performs an external call to the collateral asset contract without a reentrancy guard or state updates
The external token transfer can callback into pull, reentering the contract

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only used to initialize the collateralAsset immutable, so it collapses into the constructor
Constructor parameter only used to initialize the loan immutable, so it collapses into the constructor
dst is a local parameter of pull consumed by the token transfer and normalizes into the pull function
amt is a local parameter of pull consumed by the token transfer and normalizes into the pull function
